description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'SessionModelUtils' for saving, loading, and clearing the state of an 'InitializationWizardModel' object from an HTTP session. It uses reflection to access fields of the model, excluding sensitive ones like passwords, and prefixes session attributes with 'setup.'.

classes.name: SessionModelUtils
classes.description: A utility class for persisting and restoring the state of an InitializationWizardModel object to and from an HttpSession, with methods to save, load, and clear session attributes related to wizard initialization.

methods.name: saveToSession
methods.description: Saves all non-null, non-sensitive fields of InitializationWizardModel to the HttpSession with a 'setup.' prefix.

methods.name: loadFromSession
methods.description: Restores fields of InitializationWizardModel from session attributes with the 'setup.' prefix, excluding sensitive ones.

methods.name: clearWizardSessionAttributes
methods.description: Removes all session attributes that start with the 'setup.' prefix, effectively clearing saved wizard state.
